quote.text: He who is greedy of credit and reputation after his death, doth not consider, that they themselves by whom he is remembered, shall soon after every one of them be dead; and they likewise that succeed those; until at last all memory, which hitherto by the succession of men admiring and soon after dying hath had its course, be quite extinct.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that the lasting influence you impart on your children is not measured by fleeting accolades but by the enduring virtues of honesty, integrity, and compassion you instill.
    • Focus on nurturing inner growth rather than seeking external validation—your legacy is built daily through the quiet guidance and genuine care you offer.
  • Leadership:
    • True leadership is found in serving others with humility and wisdom, rather than chasing the ephemeral glow of public praise and reputation.
    • Embrace a leadership style that prioritizes the well-being and growth of your team, understanding that real influence comes from lasting, virtuous actions rather than the pursuit of immortal fame.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, focus on creating lasting value that satisfies genuine needs rather than chasing short-term recognition or market trends.
    • Let your work be driven by principles of integrity and continuous improvement, knowing that the impact of a well-crafted product endures far beyond the temporary spotlight of accolades.
